dog.description_text:
Meet Air Fryer! 💛

Air Fryer ears, those eyes, that face! Air Fryer is a handsome 2-year-old, approximately 35-pound Sheltie mix who came to us from a hoarding case and is ready to find his forever home!

Air Fryer is an energetic, affectionate, social boy who loves his walks, meeting new people, and being part of the action. Whether he’s hanging out at home or tagging along to the office, Air Fryer is happy to be by your side!

This smart cookie is also eager to learn! He’s food-motivated (and we mean REALLY loves his food!), responds well to verbal commands and his clicker, and thrives with consistent boundaries, training, and plenty of exercise.

With the right structure, guidance, and activity, Air Fryer will make a wonderful, fun-loving companion.

Could Air Fryer be your new adventure buddy and favorite coworker?

If you would like to adopt this wonderful dog, please email rescue@pupstarzrescue.org or visit www.pupstarzrescue.org for an application!
